weekly.text: Mark your calendars for the first Sunday of every month for Bingo at Flight! We will be open from 11am-3pm, with Bingo starting at 12pm.
We serve our full fish fry Friday’s 11am-10pm.
We offer a limited fish fry on Wednesdays too from 11am-9pm.
